creator: Karim Eldamaty
scope: Selected useful free routes, not an exhaustive list of every website. Paid extras are excluded.

sites.name: GitHub Releases
sites.nextStep: Public Mac/Windows Test downloads and editable source.

sites.name: itch.io
sites.nextStep: Mac and Windows software page; optional payments follow itch.io terms.

sites.name: SourceForge
sites.nextStep: Free open-source hosting and directory. Separate account; import releases and public source.

sites.name: GitLab
sites.nextStep: Free source-project hosting within its quotas; a mirror adds maintenance work.

sites.name: Scoop custom bucket
sites.nextStep: Pinned complete Windows ZIP; schema/payload checked, actual install/uninstall untested.

sites.name: WinGet
sites.nextStep: Community manifest, unattended install checks, contributor agreement and review required.

sites.name: Microsoft Store
sites.nextStep: New-flow developer registration is free; identity check, MSIX and certification required.

sites.name: Product Hunt
sites.nextStep: Free personal account. Posting eligibility/onboarding applies; no paid promotion needed.

sites.name: AlternativeTo
sites.nextStep: Email-verified account and review. Free queue can be long; optional paid priority is excluded.

sites.name: Show HN
sites.nextStep: Share the runnable project with a personal account; be ready to discuss it.

sites.name: DEV Community
sites.nextStep: Explain the build and link the source/downloads; it is an article rather than an app store.

sites.name: LinkedIn
sites.nextStep: Basic organic posts can link the project; confirm the publishing account.

sites.name: YouTube
sites.nextStep: Upload a finished demonstration, add the website and download link in its description.

sites.name: TikTok
sites.nextStep: Upload a finished vertical clip from your account; link availability depends on account features.

sites.name: Instagram
sites.nextStep: Share a finished Reel and the project link through your profile/story options.

sites.name: Google Search Console
sites.nextStep: Free crawl/indexing tools; verify ownership and submit the sitemap. Inclusion/ranking is not guaranteed.

sites.name: Bing Webmaster Tools
sites.nextStep: Free search tools; verify the site and submit the sitemap.

candidates.name: MacUpdate
candidates.status: Account/review needed; public submission guide does not confirm the listing fee
candidates.note: Mac-only. Confirm a no-fee route after sign-in before using it.
